local_review.finding_body: ClassPathInnerClassInfoTest accepted ClassInfo.load() failures by checking the native-image runtime property and a library-wrapped ClassNotFoundException instead of positively proving GraalVM's UnsupportedFeatureError. The attempted operation loads generated bytecode from a runtime-created temporary class path after the native executable is built, so it is unsupported open-ended dynamic class loading; the library-level ClassNotFoundException leaves the refusal unverifiable. Re-scoping the test to ClassPath's public discovery API preserves meaningful native-compatible assertions and keeps the remaining shipped metadata justified. Finalization also reproduced a MissingReflectionRegistrationError for Finalizer.startFinalizer; the prior tested version contained the two FinalizableReference/Finalizer registrations required by this unchanged library behavior.
local_review.finding_title: Unverifiable native class-loading tolerance and missing Finalizer metadata
local_review.fix_note: Removed the unverifiable ClassInfo.load() scenario and its native-specific exception branches while retaining public ClassPath discovery assertions. Restored the FinalizableReference.finalizeReferent and Finalizer.startFinalizer reflection registrations, then regenerated statistics. A second exact finalization run passed and left the publishable tree unchanged.
local_review.review_comment: The repaired contribution is scoped to com.google.guava:guava:33.7.0-jre, retains meaningful public ClassPath behavior, uses only reachability-metadata.json, and passes the repair coverage gates. Regenerated dynamic-access coverage is 116/120 overall, 113/116 for reflection, and 3/4 for resources versus 119/119, 115/115, and 4/4 respectively; none exceeds the applicable blocking threshold. The exact finalization command then passed without further publishable changes, including current-defaults latest GraalVM, future-defaults latest GraalVM, current-defaults GraalVM 25, metadata validation, formatting, Checkstyle, and regenerated statistics.
